name: Traverses Component
description: The path role of a compound edge (req-grid-edge-compound): a middle node -> each component its path passes through. Three kinds use it: an Amazon Inspector v2 network-reachability finding, to each route table, security group and network ACL its networkPath.steps passes through (collectors/boto3_collector/inspector.py, aws-core-tap#261); a VPC Network Access Analyzer finding, to each component between its path's first and last, of the types the Network Access Analyzer guide lists as path resources; and a Reachability Analyzer analysis, to each component between the first and last of its ForwardPathComponents, of the types the Reachability Analyzer guide lists as path components (collectors/boto3_collector/network_insights.py, aws-core-tap#212, #248). The property step is the component's position in the path (0-based), not identity. A reference that retires nothing: deleting a component ends this edge and leaves the middle node.

step.description: The component's 0-based position in the path: in networkPath.steps as Inspector returned them, or in a Network Access Analyzer finding's FindingComponents or a Reachability Analyzer analysis's ForwardPathComponents in SequenceNumber order.
